name: AL.com / Alabama Media Group editorial board
lean_basis: Alabama's largest news organization (Birmingham News, Huntsville Times, Mobile Press-Register legacy). Its opinion page could not be opened this run (site blocked), and no 2026 endorsement editorial surfaced in search. It last made a widely covered candidate call in 2017 (against Roy Moore). Treated as not endorsing in 2026 until an editorial is found.

name: Alabama Reflector (voter guide, no endorsements)
lean_basis: Nonprofit newsroom (States Newsroom). Publishes a candidate-by-candidate voter guide and amendment explainers but does not endorse. Included so the guide can link its coverage.

name: League of Women Voters of Alabama (VOTE411)
lean_basis: Nonpartisan; does not endorse candidates. Publishes candidate questionnaire answers on VOTE411. Its president publicly opposed Amendment 3 in October 2026.

name: Alabama Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; certified and supports its general-election nominees.

name: Alabama Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; certified and supports its general-election nominees.

name: Alabama Farmers Federation (FarmPAC)
lean_basis: Largest farm organization in the state. Its 2026 general-election slate is all Republican; President Jimmy Parnell said he believes 'the majority of Alabama voters support family values, smaller government, lower taxes and less regulation.'

name: Business Council of Alabama (ProgressPAC)
lean_basis: State chamber of commerce. Its PAC describes 'a conservative approach to the bench' and its 2026 statewide picks are all Republican.

name: Alabama Realtors PAC (ARPAC)
lean_basis: Trade-association PAC. Its Oct. 5, 2026 general-election slate is all Republican.

name: Alabama AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation; endorses through its COPE committee, historically for Democratic candidates. No 2026 general-election slate was found online this run.

name: Alabama Education Association (A-VOTE)
lean_basis: Teachers' association; endorses candidates of both parties through its A-VOTE committee, with a focus on public-school funding. No 2026 general-election slate was found online this run.

name: Alabama Arise
lean_basis: Nonprofit coalition focused on low-income Alabamians; does not endorse candidates but publishes a voter guide and sometimes takes amendment positions. No 2026 amendment positions found this run.

name: Alabama Policy Institute
lean_basis: Self-described conservative think tank; has published an amendment guide in past cycles. AG nominee Katherine Robertson is a former vice president. No 2026 amendment guide found this run.
